name: get_gaia_connection
title: Get Gaia connection
description: Return the effective local Gaia connection URL, whether an API key is configured, and its source. Never return the key. Saved settings take precedence over NARUMI_GAIA_URL / NARUMI_GAIA_API_KEY; a saved null URL explicitly disables Gaia. This does not contact Gaia. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: invalid_argument, internal.
